cluster.description: Global cluster settings controlling the Slurm controller daemon behavior and storage.

cluster.control_machine.description: Hostname or IP of the node running slurmctld.

cluster.debug_level.description: Verbosity level for Slurm daemon logs.

cluster.slurmctld_parameters.description: Comma-separated list of slurmctld parameter flags.

cluster.private_key_path.description: Path to the private key for job credential validation.

cluster.public_key_path.description: Path to the public key for job credential validation.

cluster.accounting_storage_user.description: User ID used to connect to SlurmDBD.

cluster.slurm_user.description: System user under which Slurm daemons run.

cluster.munge_key_path.description: Path to the Munge authentication key file.

cluster.message_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for internal Slurm messages.

cluster.switch_type.description: Type of network switch plugin to load.

cluster.task_plugin.description: List of task plugins to load (e.g., cgroup).

cluster.power_plugin.description: List of power management plugins to load.

nodes.items.description: Definition of a single compute node.

nodes.items.name.description: Unique name of the compute node.

nodes.items.address.description: IP address or hostname of the node.

nodes.items.cpus.description: Number of CPUs available on the node.

partitions.items.description: Definition of a single Slurm partition.

partitions.items.node_list.description: List of nodes belonging to the partition (e.g., node[001-004]).

partitions.items.def_mem_per_cpu.description: Default memory allocation per CPU in megabytes.
